name: models
description: Discover which LLM providers and models are READY on this venue under your identity, and how to choose one. Load before setting llmOperation/model for any agent.

content.inline:
## Models
Call `v/ops/langchain/models` `{provider?}` -> `{providers: [{op, provider, keySecret, ready, models, url?, note?}]}`.

Reading the answer:
- `ready` is CALLER-RELATIVE: for hosted providers it means YOUR secret store holds the provider's key (`keySecret` names it; the value is never shown). For ollama it means the server at `url` is reachable — and its `models` list is the live installed set.
- Hosted `models` lists are HINTS (conservative built-ins; the operator extends them via venue config `adapters.langchain.models.<provider>`). Any id the provider accepts works.

Choosing:
- Pick a provider with `ready: true`. Configure the agent: `llmOperation` = the entry's `op`, `model` = a model id, `apiKey` = `"s/<keySecret>"`.
- Not ready? Store the key first (secrets skill: set `{name: <keySecret>, value}`), or for ollama fix reachability (the entry's `note` names the venue knob).
- Ollama + tools: pick a tool-capable model — qwen2.5 works well; the Gemma family does not tool-call usefully. Tool-free agents can use any model.
- anthropic honours `maxTokens` (its API requires one; a default applies). `temperature`/`topP` pass through to every provider.

Gotcha when creating agents: templates default to openai/gpt-5.4-mini — on a venue where openai is not ready for you, override `llmOperation`/`model`/`apiKey` at create time or the new agent fails at its first LLM call. Check readiness BEFORE delegating to a freshly made agent.
